items.headline: Low Water Advisory issued November 23 at 8:38AM CST until November 24 at 9:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.description:
* WHAT...Abnormally low water levels.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM CST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Below normal water levels will result in hazardous
navigating conditions.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Forecasted low tides will be near or below
1.0 ft below Mean Low Low Water through the next several days.
items.instruction:
Mariners should navigate shallow waters with extreme caution due
to below normal water levels.
